design.name: 炮仗傀儡
design.brief: A firecracker puppet (炮仗傀儡), an artillery construct of the fire god's forge built like a giant temple-fair wooden marionette whose strings have burnt off: a stout top-heavy puppet about 1.9 m tall of red-lacquered wood and bamboo with visible ball joints, a big round carved wooden head with a painted grinning opera face (red cheeks, bold black brows, gold accents) and a small black cap with a red pompom. Its whole chest is a hexagonal red-and-black wooden Ming rocket box (一窝蜂) packed with a honeycomb of rocket-arrow tubes with paper fuses; long strings of red firecrackers (鞭炮) hang over its shoulders like bandoliers. At the bottom of the rocket box, at its belly, a brass powder chamber with a fuse port glows lava orange (weak spot). Jointed wooden hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers; chunky wooden feet with five carved toes. Jolly-looking and very dangerous.
design.weapon: no handheld weapon: the hexagonal rocket box on its chest firing a volley of rockets into the sky, sparks at the fuses, both empty hands raised
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright, feet apart, arms in a relaxed A-pose a little away from the body, both wooden hands open and EMPTY with the fingers slightly spread; the round head facing straight ahead with the painted grinning face; the rocket box on its chest closed with every tube capped and no rockets flying; the firecracker strings hanging calmly over the shoulders; the powder chamber at the belly painted opaque glowing orange (no sparks, no smoke, no halo)
design.turnaround_digits: each wooden hand with a separate thumb and four fingers, each foot with five carved toes, clearly countable; the cap pompom and the firecracker strings fully inside the frame.
